name: REDRIVER2
description:
REDRIVER2 is an open-source reverse-engineering effort and native PC port of Driver 2, the classic 2000 PlayStation action driving game by Reflections Interactive. It brings John Tanner's undercover crime saga natively to PC.

Features:
- Native PC execution delivering smooth 60 FPS gameplay without console stutter
- High-resolution rendering with true widescreen aspect ratios and draw distance tweaks
- Reconstructed physics engine matching original vehicle handling and car damage
- Full modern gamepad support with analog steering, acceleration, and rumble
- Play across all four iconic cities: Chicago, Havana, Las Vegas, and Rio de Janeiro
